discovery.auth: craigslist account credentials for paid bulk posting

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Craigslist Bulkpost API (OpenAPI spec) for paid posting accounts to create/modify posts; reference web services give taxonomy only; no listing search API.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://bapi.craigslist.org/bulkpost-docs/v1/): Craigslist Bulkpost API (OpenAPI spec) for paid posting accounts to create/modify posts; reference web services give taxonomy only; no listing search API. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
